## Summary
Muhammad Farhan is an Indonesian Fullstack Web Developer, Software Engineer, and founder of HanDigital digital agency. With 4+ years of practical development experience, he specializes in building high-performance web applications, SaaS platforms, enterprise ERP systems, and modern landing pages with clean architectures and production-grade security.

## Professional Unit: HanDigital (https://handigital.biz.id)
Farhan leads HanDigital, a specialized digital studio offering:
1. Web Application & SaaS Development: Enterprise dashboards, MVP SaaS, recurring billing, RBAC.
2. Enterprise Information Systems (ERP): Inventory management, POS retail systems, digital accounting, administrative archives.
3. High-Speed Landing Pages & Company Profiles: Modern editorial aesthetic, sub-second load times, 100/100 Core Web Vitals, conversion-focused design.
4. UI/UX Product Design: Interactive prototyping, wireframing, component design systems in Figma.
